capability.title: Store Locations & Map
capability.description: Directory of store locations that pairs a details card per store, with photo, address, hours, phone, and a directions link, with one embedded map of all locations.
useWhen: A page should list physical store locations with their address, hours, and phone
Guests need a map and per-store directions for the same set of locations
avoidWhen: There are no physical locations to visit
A single address needs only one line of copy without a map
